semantic_equivalence: the supported operator and identity fragment is unchanged from V1
each output row still maps to exactly one source record
source and output identities remain contextual SHA-256 values
independent verification still recomputes edges from actual output rows

encoding_change.v1: one Python object and repeated JSON source context per edge
encoding_change.v2: one shared header plus two fixed 32-byte digests per edge

development_gates: all V1 semantic and tamper-detection tests remain passing
compact edge bytes equal exactly 64 times the edge count
serialized bytes per edge are lower than V1 at every row count
capture and verification medians are reported without hiding regressions
decision_policy: This remains development evidence and cannot authorize a paper performance claim.
Formal scaling is admitted only after reviewing both latency and storage results.
The V1 baseline remains immutable even if V2 improves it.
